about.name: Arun Kumar
about.title: Principal Solutions Architect & Technical Consultant

about.summary: Principal Technical Consultant with 15+ years of experience in enterprise software development, platform engineering, cloud modernization, DevOps, full stack application development, and technical consulting. Experienced in designing, developing, deploying, and modernizing enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, React, Angular, Node.js, AWS, Docker, and CI/CD technologies.

caseStudies.title: Brain Mentors Pvt Ltd (Senior Technical Consultant)

sections.heading: Core Responsibilities & Platform Operations
sections.content: Responsible for platform engineering, cloud modernization, infrastructure planning, deployment automation, technical operations, and engineering coordination across digital learning platforms. Managed technical operations for Brain Mentors and SkillRisers platforms, coordinating a team of 3–5 engineers across platform and development initiatives.

sections.heading: Key Infrastructure Contributions
sections.content: Led AWS to Hetzner Cloud migration planning and execution initiatives. Coordinated infrastructure modernization activities focused on cost optimization, platform reliability, and scalability. Designed containerized deployment strategies using Docker and Docker Compose for improved operational consistency.

sections.heading: CI/CD & Engineering Governance
sections.content: Supported CI/CD automation pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins. Implemented code quality workflows involving centralized SonarQube deployment, static code analysis integration, and quality gates into live development paths.

sections.heading: Solution Engineering & Architecture Guidance
sections.content: Collaborated with enterprise engineering teams and technology organizations to deliver consulting engagements, architecture guidance, technical evaluations, code reviews, and technology adoption initiatives. Supported engineering readiness, technical mentoring, capability-building programs, curriculum architecture, project design, and technical interview engineering assessments.

sections.heading: Enterprise Engagements & Partnerships
sections.content: IBM, Capgemini, LTI Mindtree, Wipro, Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Accenture, Genpact, ABB, UST Global

sections.heading: Corporate Consulting & Project Support
sections.content: Provided freelance consulting, corporate programs, software development guidance, and technology enablement services. Delivered implementation support for Java, Spring, AngularJS, MEAN Stack, Android, and enterprise application development initiatives involving MVC architecture, Struts, databases, and automated testing frameworks.

sections.heading: Client & Program Exposure
sections.content: Snapdeal, Wipro, Cognizant, HCL Technologies, NIIT Technologies, Boeing

caseStudies.title: Techknow Heights Pvt Ltd (Software Developer to Technical Lead)

sections.heading: Enterprise Learning Platform Evolved
sections.content: Designed and developed a large-scale learning and assessment ecosystem supporting online tests, reporting, learner management, and progress tracking. Designed and implemented enterprise applications using Java, Servlets, JSP, Spring MVC, Struts, MySQL, and Apache Tomcat.

sections.heading: Modernization tracks & Leadership
sections.content: Managed a development team of approximately five engineers. Led modernization efforts that successfully migrated the legacy infrastructure platform towards clean MEAN-based architectures.

caseStudies.title: Research Project: Secure Online Coding Assessment Sandbox

sections.heading: Architecture Framework Specs
sections.content: Researched and evaluated solution alternatives for a high-availability coding assessment platform supporting secure multi-language code execution. Evaluated Judge0 and JSJail execution architectures, secure Docker sandboxing environments, CPU/Memory resource isolation thresholds, and scalability deployment models.
